pairedBootstrapScopeClarification: Existing bootstrap uses all 12 families, conditional on their shared full-pool feasibility; it does not filter the seven common-job families. Its intervals must not be called common-job gate intervals.

pairedCIs.estimand: difference in equal-family weighted acceptable coverage, conditional on common full-pool oracle feasibility; same denominator as policy summaries
pairedCIs.method: paired two-stage family then base resampling; profile jobs remain clustered within base; unavailable-oracle bases remain in sampling frame with zero feasible denominator
pairedCIs.caution: Only two fresh heldout bases per family; interval is descriptive and cannot establish population prevalence.
